_comment: Item definitions. Ported from the Rails InventoryItem STI subclasses (wood became carbon). category: material | lootbox | placeable | source. Items with a lootTable can be opened with the Use action. Items with stackSize 1 get a unique instance id. Enclosures (placeable with maxExposureStacks > 0) hold one loot box and one radiation source; sources name a radiation id from radiation.json. The loot_box item is shown to players as the Quantum Cache (ids keep the old name).

items.tooltip: Elementary carbon, injected through the event horizon. Light, versatile, and the backbone of most structures.
Elementary iron, injected through the event horizon. Dense and strong.
A sealed cache of compressed matter in superposition: what's inside isn't decided until it's observed. Use it to open it and collapse it.
A light, graphite-lined radiation chamber. Contains radiation up to tier 4 (microwaves). Holds one quantum cache and one source.
A heavy steel-plated radiation chamber. Contains any radiation up to tier 7 (gamma). Holds one quantum cache and one source.
A broad-spectrum lamp. Visible light drives photosynthesis: caches yield more carbon.
Heats and cures what it shines on: caches get extra rolls.
Ore extraction: caches yield more iron.
Observation: collapses a cache early. Its contents are revealed and fixed, and nothing changes it after that.
Mutation: caches may collapse into more caches. Needs an iron enclosure.
